cars.generation: Original pre-facelift Taycan production-road electric sports-saloon family
cars.variant: Turbo S — 4 September 2019 North American introduction
cars.specification_market: Original five-page PCNA release No.73/19, visually read throughout. Selected Turbo S, not Turbo. 560 kW is overboost with Launch Control, not continuous output; 93.4 kWh is overall capacity. EPA range was pending. Later facelift, Turbo GT, Cross Turismo, optional PDCC and unqualified record claims are excluded.
cars.summary: The original Taycan marked Porsche’s entry into production electric sports cars. Its 800-volt architecture, dual-motor drive and two-speed rear transmission make the Turbo S a landmark performance-engineering reference for the family.
cars.admission_reason: The original Taycan marked Porsche’s entry into production electric sports cars. Its 800-volt architecture, dual-motor drive and two-speed rear transmission make the Turbo S a landmark performance-engineering reference for the family.
